title: Eval harness: CI prompt-regression metrics integration and gating
author: Priya Patel
description: Motivation: Add a lightweight CI hook to surface prompt-set regressions and tie eval-harness metrics into our gating pipeline so PRs that cause quality regressions fail early. This change implements a new eval CI hook that runs a delta comparison against the baseline prompt-set metrics, publishes a compact metrics blob to the CI artifacts, and triggers the quality gate when delta thresholds are exceeded. Scope: eval-harness CI hook + metrics reporter + small refactor to existing prompt-set runner to export per-prompt IDs and scores. Checklist: - [x] Implement CI hook that runs prompt-set regressions (local runner + CI wrapper) - [x] Add metrics reporter integration that pushes summarized metrics to CI artifact storage - [x] Add gating logic and threshold config to ci/configs/eval-harness.yml - [x] Add unit and integration tests - [x] Add docs and examples for creating baseline prompt-sets and interpreting gating failures Implementation notes: - New CI hook at ci/hooks/eval_prompt_regression.sh (wrapper around python runner) - New reporter at eval-harness/integrations/metrics/metrics_reporter.py that emits a compact JSON summary and Prometheus-compatible metrics for post-merge analysis - The gating step compares delta metrics (accuracy, nll, coverage) against per-prompt thresholds stored alongside the baseline artifact - Added conservative default thresholds to avoid false positives (configurable via Linear ENG-4021) Tests: added tests/eval/test_prompt_regression.py with mocked metrics and an end-to-end integration job in .github/workflows/eval-harness.yml Rollback plan: revert the gating step and disable the CI hook via feature flag in ci/configs/eval-harness.yml Related: ENG-4021, ENG-4100, previous eval-harness gating PRs (see pr-61234, pr-148900).
commits: feat: add eval CI hook and wrapper (run baseline comparison)
feat: metrics reporter for compact CI artifacts and prometheus metrics
test: add unit and integration tests for prompt regression gating

release_notes: Adds CI hook and metrics integration for prompt-set regression gating. This introduces a configurable quality gate for eval-harness that can fail PRs when prompt-level metrics regress beyond configured thresholds. Configurable via ci/configs/eval-harness.yml.
